title: Permutational immune analysis reveals architectural similarities between inflammaging, Down syndrome and autoimmunity
description: Permutational analysis of immune landscape reveals advanced immune aging in people with Down syndrome and in people with type 1 diabetes. Overall design: Perumtative comparison of Typical Control individuals to those with Down Syndrome and/or other auto-immune diseases
